title: Wave Navigation in the Marshall Islands: Comparing Indigenous and Western Scientific Knowledge of the Ocean
version: Oceanography 22(2), 234–245; original publisher PDF. Website upload date 2015 is not the research date.
lineage: Collaborative original research with navigators as coauthors. Introduction, Methods, practical wave descriptions, Wapepe section, oceanographic comparisons and limitations inspected. Fieldwork is dated 2005–2006; individual buoy dates are not given here. The WAM participant account below places deployments during that field year; no exact days are claimed. Reflected-wave and dilep claims remain unresolved; simulation is not treated as proof of every navigational explanation.

passages.note: Dates the field instruction and observed navigation, including a 220-km voyage.

passages.quote: Captain Korent guided the wave buoy deployments.
passages.note: Explicit relation between navigational expertise and instrumental sampling; Datawell G-4 sensor and 30-minute spectra described nearby.
